d: Bhajan clubbing is rapidly emerging as India’s most unexpected cultural crossover, and we went behind the reels and hype to see exactly why these high-octane spiritual gatherings are drawing such massive crowds. In this video, we hit the ground to chat with attendees of all ages to uncover the magnetic pull of this format, exploring how traditional hymns found a new home in high-energy social spaces. Beyond the rhythmic chanting and infectious energy, we also dive into the political undercurrents that have pushed this trend into the mainstream. This is an investigative look at a movement…
